snippet.title: PRIPYAT: EXCLUSION ZONE - InfinitByte Studios
snippet.description: Return to Pripyat in this short 16-bit retro survival game. Collect 5 documents, manage radiation, and fight mutants. Can you escape the exclusion zone in under 5 minutes?
